hook: Qualcomm's laptop CPU now rivals x86

beats.say: Chips and Cheese dug into Oryon 3, the core behind the Snapdragon X2 Elite, which can challenge the best x86 chips on CPU performance.
Qualcomm uses twice as many performance cores as efficiency cores, the inverse of Intel's hybrid approach.
The core sustains about four NOPs per cycle from L2, double Oryon 1, and its L1 data TLB grew from 224 to 256 entries, covering a full megabyte with 4 KB pages.
